question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- For each year, find the last race_id that has constructor standings, then get top driver and constructor
WITH last_cs_race AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(cs.race_id) as last_cs_race_id
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT lcr.year, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lcr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) as rn
    FROM last_cs_race lcr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.race_id = lcr.last_cs_race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT lcr.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lcr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) as rn
    FROM last_cs_race lcr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lcr.last_cs_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT td.year, 
       td.forename || ' ' || td.surname AS driver_full_name,
       td.points AS driver_points,
       tc.constructor_name,
       tc.points AS constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
WHERE td.rn = 1 AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY td.year
